protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: In the vulnerable code, js_atomics_get_ptr computes a raw TypedArray backing-store pointer before JS_ToIntegerFree, JS_ToUint32, or JS_ToBigInt conversion. An attacker-controlled valueOf can call rab.resize(0); js_array_buffer_resize reallocates the non-shared RAB backing store without marking it detached, so the post-conversion detached check does not reject the stale pointer before atomic_store or atomic_fetch operations. Issues 1301 and 1302 supply matching PoCs and ASAN UAF traces.
